objective: LungVision AI — Phase 6D Reproducible MultiScaleDenseNet121-FPN Training & Validation.
acceptance_criteria: Gate A: Environment & Data Audit (Audit RTX 3050 4GB GPU, CPU, RAM, PyTorch version, manifest, patient splits, zero leakage; export phase6d_environment_audit.json and phase6d_dataset_split_audit.json).
Gate B: Matched Preprocessing Experiments (Matched 224x224 direct resize vs matched 512x512 letterbox; document interpolation, padding, orientation; export phase6d_preprocessing_config.json).

Gate C: Genuine Model Training & Convergence (Train MultiScaleDenseNet121-FPN 512x512 with Focal Loss over multiple epochs; record losses, per-class AUROC/AUPRC, learning rate, latency; export phase6d_training_history.json).
Gate D: Checkpoint Export (Export multiscale_densenet121_fpn_512_v1.pth, record SHA-256, config, manifest hashes; export phase6d_checkpoint_manifest.json).
Gate E: Controlled Model Comparison (Compare Production 224, Experimental 224, and Experimental 512 on matched cohorts; export phase6d_model_comparison.json).
Gate F: Calibration Evaluation (Fit on validation cohort, evaluate on test cohort; keep frozen production thresholds unchanged; export phase6d_calibration_report.json).
Gate G: Statistical Analysis (Patient-cluster bootstrap 95% CIs resampling patients rather than images; paired comparisons with effect sizes; export phase6d_patient_cluster_statistics.json).

Gate H: Error Analysis & Reproducibility Report (Audit 6 disease classes with Grad-CAM, anatomy, AP view; export phase6d_error_analysis.json and author authoritative PHASE_6D_REPRODUCIBLE_TRAINING_REPORT.md with reproducible training & eval commands).
non_goals: Do not overwrite or modify production DenseNet121 weights (SHA-256: 8d3690cd0438587a94afb8fd2ad84c0b30f9c1cc2727ee0eb03662a02ea020af)
Do not alter frozen NIH production classification thresholds
Do not overwrite Phase 5B through Phase 6C artifacts
Do not use test data for training, model selection or calibration
Do not claim convergence without documented multi-epoch training evidence
Do not claim clinical diagnostic validity or external 3D reconstruction validation from CXR datasets
